messages:
Ari: Heads-up, CI evals on master are failing for the quantized Llama-2-v4 run. Intermittent assertion: `stable_metric_consistency_check failed: delta=0.035` across a few seeds. Saw it ~09:12 UTC. Anyone seeing the same?
Sam: saw it on my run too, reproduces ~30% of the time locally. Failing only on q8 kernel.
EvalBot: [alert] eval-runner/1976234567: 5 failures in last 10m for job=quant-eval; flaky=true; sample-log attached.
Nia: can you paste the failing stack? also which runner image?
Sam: here are the last lines: `AssertionError: delta 0.035 >= threshold 0.02
 at eval.metrics.consistency: line 143`
Sam: runner image `redwood/runner:latest-2026-03-20` on A100-80GB pool.
Jordan: quick note — we rolled PR 5412 yesterday that changed batch-scheduling + KV eviction timing in runner. Could affect quant kernels edge cases.
Ari: hmm, PR 5412 also toggled `batch_compression=true` by default for dedicated pools. That could change perf profiles and maybe trigger nondeterminism in q8 path.
Nia: I'll run a bisect across commits between a12f4 and 5412. Give me 20m.
Sasha: adding hold on the model rollout in console: canary paused and traffic routed to fallback variant. :no_entry_sign:
Nia: quick update — bisect narrowed it to commit `5412` (the batching/eviction change). Reproduces when batch_compression=on.
Sam: replicated locally: toggling `--batch-compression=false` makes the assertion disappear across 50 seeds.
Jordan: that suggests a timing/order interaction not a pure quantization bug. Maybe micro-batching reorders KV cache writes.
Ari: agree. For safety: hold on canary until we patch. No global rollback yet.
Nia: file with repro steps: `./tools/eval_runner --model llm-v4-q8 --seeds 0..49 --batch-compression=true --log-level debug`
Nia: relevant diff from bisect: `runner/scheduler.py` changed `flush_on_evict=True` -> `False` and introduced compression path that batches cache writes.
Sam: logs show slight token misalignment in generated strings (whitespace) between baseline and compressed path. Metric compares normalized strings so delta spikes.
Ari: two action items: 1) revert batch_compression default (quick patch to runner flags), 2) add guard in eval harness to normalize outputs robustly for quantized runs and widen the gating threshold for the canary temporarily.
Jordan: I'll open a PR to set `batch_compression=false` for q8 pipelines and add a unit test that replays the failing seed.
Sasha: I've increased alert sensitivity and annotated the canary page with the bisect link.
Nia: also creating a small telemetry job to run compressed vs uncompressed on a small corpus to see regression magnitude over time.
Ari: sounds good. No rollback of the model image yet, just pause rollout + runner flag change. We should have a patch PR and CI green before unpausing.
Sam: ping me on the PR for quick review. :thumbsup:
EvalBot: [info] ticket created: INF-3187 "bisect -> batch_compression interaction causing eval spikes" assigned to Jordan/Nia.
Ari: thanks all. Keep updates here and let's avoid spinning up more canaries until patch lands.
